description: A U_PDU that asked for node delivery confirmation is confirmed to its client with S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM when the CAS confirms it; the configured wait runs from when it is handed to the CAS.
note: Link setup and data path as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with node delivery confirmation (Service Type 0x14: Transmission Mode ARQ, Delivery Confirmation 1), its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST of 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 is held for a soft link while the CAS calls, and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link and the U_PDU goes down to the CAS (A-0194, A-0217 to A-0220); at 108000 it goes on air in one DATA-ONLY, and at 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. On acceptance the U_PDU asked for confirmation and is held for a soft link, so its wait runs to its TTD, 0 + 648000 x 2000 ms (interp A-0232, A-0342): sis.confirm_wait starts with 1296000000 ms, the only entry in the deadline list. When it is handed to the CAS at 91000 its wait becomes sis.confirm_wait_ms, 300000 ms (A-0221; interp A-0232): the head deadline moves from 1296000000 to 391000, so sis.confirm_wait restarts with 300000 ms, after the soft link maximum and before the DTS starts dts.ttd for the C_PDU. At 126000 the peer's ACK-ONLY acknowledges FSN 0, the DTS confirms the C_PDU (C-0679, C-1130) and cancels its timers, and the CAS passes C_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM up: the client gets S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM (A-0094, A-0095, A-0222) with the request's destination SAP 9 and address 0.0.1.3 (SIZE 7) and the whole U_PDU, size 4, since sis.frag_size is unset (A-0096 to A-0099). The list is now empty, so sis.confirm_wait is cancelled, and with nothing outstanding sis.soft_link_idle starts (interp A-0320). Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080).
